## filtlong installation

code to install filtlong

```{bash}
conda create -n filtlong_env -c bioconda filtlong
```

## Run filtlong on yeast genome

filtlong bash tool is used to filter the long reads based on certain criteria such as average Q score

```{bash}
filtlong --keep_percent 75 data/ERR1539006.fastq.gz > outputs/filtlong_filtered_reads.fastq
```

## Run sequali on filtered genome

```{bash}
sequali outputs/filtlong_filtered_reads.fastq --outdir outputs
```

## R code chunk 

rqc tool performs quality check on short read files

```{r}
qcres <- rqc(path = "data/", pattern = "^ERR11203340_.*\\.fastq\\.gz$", pair = c(1,1), openBrowser=FALSE, outdir="outputs")
```

# Sequencing quality per base/cycle

quality score drops below 2 at cycle 101

```{r}
rqcCycleQualityBoxPlot(qcres)
```

# Sequence content per base/cycle

Highest proportion for Ns is 0% because the line for N sits completely flat at the bottom of the grass across all the cycles

```{r}
rqcCycleBaseCallsLinePlot(qcres)
```

# Read frequency plot

Most of the sequences do not have more than 1 read because bars for 1 occurrence are approximately at 100%

```{r}
rqcReadFrequencyPlot(qcres)
```
